title: First-value contract
description: The observable loop that proves a product works, and the evidence for each step. Written with core-interaction-contract before architecture is chosen.

successful_path.description: Observable steps someone could watch, in order. Not a feature list — a feature cannot be observed failing.

state_owners.description: step → the system authoritative at that step

failure_path.description: The likeliest failure that prevents value. Not 'an error occurs'.

recovery_path.description: How the user recovers without starting over.

evidence.description: A passing suite that never exercised the loop is not evidence the loop works. citation_verified and independent_reproduction exist for written-artifact deliverables (reports, plans, analyses) — without them that evidence collapses into manual_judgement, which is the exact 'looks considered, never checked' failure this schema exists to prevent.
